title: init_user_dotfiles.py
description: Initialize or evaluate user dot files (.cshrc, .bashrc, ...) for system settings.

help_dotfiles_all.description: Display dot files known by the program
help_dotfiles_all.title: Help dot files all flag

help_shells.description: Display shells known by the program
help_shells.title: Help shells flag

dot_files_list.description: Specify dot files to focus on (default from -help_dotfiles_mod)
dot_files_list.title: Dot files list

dir_bin.description: Specify bin directory to add to PATH (default comes from `which afni_proc.py`)
dir_bin.title: Bin Directory

do_updates.description: Specify which updates to make (default is nothing)
do_updates.title: Updates List

dry_run.description: Do not modify files, but see what would happen
dry_run.title: Dry Run Flag

force.description: Force edits, whether they seem needed or not
force.title: Force Flag

make_backup.description: Specify whether to make backups of originals (default is yes)
make_backup.title: Make Backup

test.description: Just test the files for potential changes
test.title: Test Flag
